items.title: An $850,000 Portfolio in Verizon, Enterprise Products and UPS Pays $51,000 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAn $850,000 portfolio split evenly across Verizon, Enterprise Products Partners and UPS pays about $51,200 a year in dividends, or about $4,270 a month. Verizon and Enterprise Products have plenty of cash behind their payouts, from businesses that are still growing.
